title: Colombia — Paro Nacional 2021
description: Protestas contra reforma tributaria. Violencia policial sin precedentes. 43 muertos durante protestas. Polarización sin precedentes.
sources: Human Rights Watch: report on deaths
Templeton et al. (2021): social media analysis
data_notes: P represents polarization_index (units: index). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: std(opinion) / 1.0. At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Polarization index: P rises during national strike, peaks, then decays. Observation operator H: std(opinion_dimension) normalized by half-range.
